party: 5 travellers, ONE booking per stop: a 2-bedroom unit, or 2 rooms (2+3 adults)
read_only_confirmation: Compiled from public pages and the private evidence file on 2026-10-04. No rate in this file was invented: every cost range is a line-by-line build whose dated lines are named in cost_basis, and the rest are estimates. No budget figure appears here — whether a range fits is decided at render time against the configured budget.
notes: legs are (origin, destination) airport pairs with no dates: the dates are derived at render time from the report's own priceable date pair, so a search link always matches the trip being priced.
cabin is what the engine prices for these routes (all of them are over eight hours from London, so BUSINESS).
confidence is 'dated-rate' only where a dated public rate or fare backs the figure, 'estimate' where every line is a build.
